svg.title: Choose your OpenAI integration
svg.desc: Two integrations side by side. The Playwright adapter exposes 4 of OpenAI's 28 browser tools on your existing Playwright page: read_page, click, type, and select_option. The Browser Use driver implements all 28 browser tools, including JavaScript, coordinate actions, and file transfers, plus Bash on your host. Both run on a Browser Use Cloud browser.
